name: VAISHNAVI ADKAR
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A speedy player with a sharp serve, consistent baseline game, and growing confidence in pressure moments, suited to fast hard courts.
Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #596 (December 30, 2024), Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #825 (December 30, 2024).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw; reached R3 at 2021 Australian Open Juniors.
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 1 ITF singles title (2024 Ahmedabad W15) and 1 doubles title (2024 Ahmedabad W15 with Pooja Ingale). Biggest Win: Defeated World No. 323 Ankita Raina at 2025 WTA 125 Mumbai R1. Junior Success: Secured 5 ITF junior singles titles, including J5 Guwahati (2021), and reached a career-high ITF Junior Ranking of #141 (2021). National Representation: Represented India at the 2021 Junior Billie Jean King Cup.
Other Highlights: Started at Deccan Gymkhana in Pune, where she trains under Sagar Kashyap. Lost to Raina in straight sets at 2024 Mumbai Open but avenged it in 2025. Aims for a Top 400 ranking by year-end 2025.
Vaishnavi’s maiden pro titles and upset wins signal her potential as an emerging Indian talent. 🎾🇮🇳
